scope: Three completed base batches, three completed20M panels and nine new followup singleton queries (two batch02, seven batch03). Seven reused batch03 played queries remain counted only in the original panel. Mac/pilots/abandoned transition costs remain separate.
limits: VM lifetime measured, compute priced at recorded rate not billed. Later panel sizes/followups vary. Existing inclusive processing/cost scenarios remain conditional, not confidence intervals, deadlines or caps. Ancillary storage/transfer/operations, taxes, retries and review pauses are not in compute mean.
time_note: Sum of sequential cloud creation-to-final-task spans, not VM-hours or end-to-end elapsed. Excludes preflight/retrieval/review. No known additional required query remains from current seven-query plan; scientific reviewers own closure.
